notes.title: Navigation Update
notes.content:
Today we are pushing out an update to HEIST to help address the pain of finding your way through the levels.

We have seen and heard a lot of players getting turned around when making their way to the Loot or an Exit.
When you're on your last Smoke Pipe and trying to make a break for the exit, the last thing you want is to take a turn to no where and end up wasting and potentially ruining your run.

To help this, we have added a compass-like pointer to give a generalised direction towards the current & relevant goal.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30950309/71eb754a663befe180f9d84e0fdbff5e761280a1.gif[/img]

The compass will only be visible when you open the Objective List (by holding [TAB] or the [Back] button on a controller). The pointer will also disappear when you've arrived at the objective.

We have also updated the 'Blueprints' in the Level Selection.
Now instead of just the Location name, you can see the Level layout, including the 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30950309/e3b3de8c4d1f4db35734db35b804c5bbf74c2e63.jpg[/img]

Happy Heisting!
~Atomizer Games

notes.title: HEIST Beta has closed
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30950309/f8475dd4d9e3a3d3aa58c504871a70b3905c6be6.png[/img]

Hello Heisters,

Today, unfortunately, marks the end of the HEIST beta. We will no longer be providing new updates to HEIST after today.

As we mentioned before, we will allow all Beta participant access to HEIST until its launch. As such this update has been focused on providing fixes and improvements to enjoy the game until the release.

Here are the core changes;
[list]
[*] We've added a confirmation popup when you select to restart
[*] We've added the option to delete your progress through the Main Menu options
[*] Added glass case smashing to the Mansion 'Loot', which triggers an alarm
[*] Fixed various colliders across all levels
[*] Added art of Tool selection button in the Main Menu
[*] Added additional HUD art for the country club pickups
[/list]

The forums will remain open for everyone to post any additional bugs you wish to bring to our attention or share run times with others.

Our sights are now set on adding the remaining art and polish to ensure the game maintains a consistent level of quality from start to finish.
We can't wait to share the game with all of you once it'd finished.

Thank you for the last 8 months of assistance and help, we couldn't have done it without you!
~Atomizer Games

notes.title: Beta Update: 0.3.10.r11
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30950309/f8475dd4d9e3a3d3aa58c504871a70b3905c6be6.png[/img]

Hello Heisters!

Today we have pushed out an update to HEIST with a focus on the Gun Guards.
In later levels, from the Casino onwards, You'll encounter guards that won't hesitate to apply deadly force to protect their employer's establishments.

We have made improvements to these guards which include the following
[list]
[*]Gun Guards will now properly track a moving player while aiming.
[*]Refined the time between Gun Guards aiming their gun and shooting at the player.
[*]Gun Guard will no longer shoot the player while being held up by the player using the 'Fake Gun' tool.
[/list]
Additionally, we have made the following improvements:
[list]
[*]Guards movement slowing by Players Tools now apply and remove from the guard properly if stacked
[*]Fixed lights in the Country Club warehouse turning off incorrectly
[*]Fixed some navmesh issues in the Country Club
[/list]

That's all for now, but as always we'd love to hear from you!
You can leave any and all suggestions and thoughts in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/420330/discussions/]General Forum[/url] And leave any bug reports in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/420330/discussions/1/]Bug Forum[/url].

'Til next time...
~Atomizer Games

notes.title: Green with progression
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30950309/f8475dd4d9e3a3d3aa58c504871a70b3905c6be6.png[/img]

Hello Heisters!

Out most recent update is hopping onto servers now after we delayed for Easter.
This iteration's update has had a focus on addressing issues with our progression saving and ensuring players can more effectively progress in levels!

We have sat down and added several more 'hiding spots' across all levels currently in the game!

For the uninitiated; hiding spots are objects, such as a desk, that the player can enter when prompted to hide.
Doing this has two intended effects
[list]
[*] Keeps the player from being spotted by guards
[*] Creates a checkpoint for the player to return to having made a mistake or been caught
[/list]
These objects are highlighted green and now have a hiding symbol near the entry point.
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30950309/72c722651eeee18cf1aaf096ddca4a30bb9784f0.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30950309/e8cfe99b4b95ba531c4fedd0fce69f22f78b0ec5.png[/img][/url]
[i]click the image to enlarge[/i]


We have also made improvements to the progression system to ensure player progress loads and saves correctly.

A handful of minor level design changes have also been included to improve the game overall

'Til next time...
~Atomizer Games

notes.title: Beta News: Build 0.3.10r8 now live!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30950309/f8475dd4d9e3a3d3aa58c504871a70b3905c6be6.png[/img]

Greetings,

Today we bring you a minor update to the game and some news on development.

In the current build, we have done a lot of updating and minor fixing, but we won't bore you with the tedious list of changes, but here's the gist.
[list]
[*]Fixed some odd guard paths
[*]Fixed the Casino depth hiding not set up correctly
[*]Fixed some art issues with the Art Gallery Get it interactables.
[*]Updated some sound files of the Gun Guards
[*]Added a UI display for when you save and load a checkpoint.
[/list]

The reason behind the light update is due to our focus on bigger fish.
We have a new level in-development, The Mansion!

The bulk of our work in recent weeks have been creating this level. While we don't have a clear date on when it will be ready for testing, we hope to share some more details on the level with you soon!

Additionally, we will now be pushing builds and news updates out on Mondays AEST.

Til next time...

~Atomizer

notes.content:

Greetings!

The latest build of Heist has gone live and here's whats changed

[list]
[*][b]Art Gallery:[/b]
[list]
[*] Now live and unlockable by completing the Casino

[i]Can be found in C:\Users\YOURUSERNAME\AppData\LocalLow\AtomizerGames\Heist'[/i]

[*] Re-added Antialiasing Quality setting

[*] Re-added Anisotropic setting

notes.title: Beta News: Plan B
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30950309/f8475dd4d9e3a3d3aa58c504871a70b3905c6be6.png[/img]

Greetings!

Last Wednesday we pushed out a big Update to steam that encapsulated a bunch of changes.
This included new content and fixes to outstanding issues we didn't didn't notice present in the initial update last weekend.
We chalk up the oversight to a lack of coffee...

So here's what has changed:
[list]

[*][b]Casino[/b]
We had begun rebuilding the street section of the Casino but wasn't finished when we pushed out the update. Since we have done more work to get the area into line with our final vision
[/list]
[*]Reduced the height of street buildings
[*]Added wall fading to Street borders
[*]Added Gun Guard to Street entrance
[*]Fixed underground transition
[/list]

[*][b]Country Club[/b]
The long-awaited changes to the Country Club are now live and ready for testing
[list]
[*]Redesigned the outer rooms for better gameplay as well as made them outdoors
[*]Converted the outer areas to be encapsulated
[*]Removed large uninteresting open area around outer rooms
[/list]

[*][b]Video configurations[/b]
[list]
[*]Re-added Monitor selection
[*]Re-added V-sync setting
[*]Re-added Texture Quality setting
[*]Added ini file generation for easily adjust settings outside of the game
[i] Can be found in C:\Users\YOURUSERNAME\AppData\LocalLow\AtomizerGames\Heist' [/i]
[/list]

[/list]

The Art Gallery at present still requires some additional work but will be available in the next Update

We are eager to hear your feedback on the Country Club and Casino updates which you can post to the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/420330/discussions]General Discussions[/url] and [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/420330/discussions/1/]Bug Forums[/url] respectively.

Happy Heisting

~Atomizer

notes.title: New Update and Holiday News!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30950309/f8475dd4d9e3a3d3aa58c504871a70b3905c6be6.png[/img]

Greetings!

As the year comes to a close, we wanted to get out one final update to the build and let you know of our plans for the Holiday season.

Here's what's been changed in build 0.3.9r1:
[list]
[*][b]Tutorial[/b]
[list]
[*]Bomb placement instruction clipping through geometry
[*]Fixed the wrong ambience SFX set for the level
[/list]

[*][b]Shipping Yard[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed some Props floating
[*]Fixed a bug where kicking open the Crate allowed you to leave hiding spots without pressing the interaction key
[/list]

[*][b]Country Club[/b]
[list]
[*]Added an effect when Looting the Filing Cabinets and Boxes
[*]Fixed Document storage boxes playing the wrong SFX when looting
[*]Ensured Lootables will play opening animation
[*]Fixed a bug where loading a checkpoint wouldn't reset the animation of opened Filing Cabinets and Boxes
[/list]

[*][b]General[/b]
[list]
[*]Updated the Art for the Paused menu
[*]Moving the mouse will now trigger a change in preferred input device
[*]Fixed an issue where new players would have their texture quality setting set to quarter
[/list]

[/list]
As always, if you come across any issues, please let us know on the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/420330/discussions/1/]Bug Forums[/url].
If you don't see the update immediately, try restarting Steam.

The next update will be in January once we get back into the swing of development.
We plan on bringing you the final design of the Country Club as well as get you all into a functional version of the Art Gallery ready for testing.

In the meantime, we recommend checking out Snortlepig's latest Community Challenge:
[url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/420330/discussions/0/1500126447402390187/]The Caffeinated Casino Caper[/url].
This one is a doozy of challenge and not for the faint-hearted.

We wish everyone and Happy Heisting Holidays! And we'll see you all in the New Year!

notes.title: Beta Build 0.3.8 is now live!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30950309/f8475dd4d9e3a3d3aa58c504871a70b3905c6be6.png[/img]
Greetings!

For this Update, we've been focused on addressing the issues with the Levels and Get It Objectives as identified by you!

Here's a break down of improvements and fixes in this update:
[list]

[*] [b]Safe Cracking - Tutorial :[/b]
The Safe wouldn't restore to its default state after loading a Checkpoint
[list]
[*] Safe door remaining open after loading a checkpoint
[*] Being unable to re-take the loot after loading a checkpoint
[*] Level Exit would remain Activated
[/list]

[*] [b]Shipping Crate - Shipping Yard:[/b]
[list]
[*] Opening animation would play after loading a checkpoint
[*] General stability improvements
[*] Spamming the kick could cause you to freeze in place
[/list]

[*] [b]Documents - Country Club:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that would freeze the player when attempting to collect loot
[*] Fixed a bug where the player would tilt when attempting to collect loot
[/list]

[*] [b]Changes to the Cherry Bomb:[/b]
[list]
[*] Reduced the cherry bomb distraction radius from 10 to 7.5
[/list]

[*] [b]Changes to the Tutorial:[/b]
[list]
[*] Modified Tutorial to factor in Cherry Bomb changes
[*] Improved the layout of the cherry bomb room to prevent players being spotted by off-screen guard
[*] Changed cherry bomb instruction text to be more direct
[/list]

[*] [b]Visual Improvements to the Shipping Yard:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added Train Platform
[*] Converted space around Dock A lobby to be Outdoors
[/list]

[*] [b]Changes to the Country Club:[/b]
There were several parts of the Country Clubs level design that we weren't happy with, and as such have begun making improvements
[list]
[*] Rebuilt Starting Area
[*] Converted Meeting Rooms into Servant Village
[*] Added Maze to South East Grounds
[*] Re-designed Lounges Layout
[*] Added Locked Get It Door combination collectables
[/list]

[*] [b]Improved various UI:[/b]
[list]
[*] Steam will now always show when pressing the Bug Report Button
[*] Removed the Bug report button appearing on the Press Any Key screen
[*] Fixed the Hotswap Dpad keys showing incorrect direction
[/list]

[/list]

The Country Club should now be playable from end-to-end without interruption.

A HUGE shout out to our community contributors to the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/420330/discussions/1/]Bug Forum[/url]!
We'll continue to tackle Bugs currently posted and any new issues uncovered in this update.

We'd like to turn your attention to [url= http://steamcommunity.com/app/420330/discussions/0/3183345176712416367/] Snortlepig's Latest Challenge: Stomping the Shipping Yard.[/url]
The goal: Beat the Shipping Yard level with the Stompers Equipped!
The Stompers can be unlocked by completing the Country Club.
Be sure to Post your results to determine who the best Thief is!

We look forward to seeing all your attempts at this Challenge and future Community Challenges!

We'd like to turn your attention to [url= http://steamcommunity.com/app/420330/discussions/0/3183345176712416367/] Snortlepig's Latest Challenge: Stomping the Shipping Yard.[/url]
The goal: Beat the Shipping Yard level with the Stompers Equipped!
The Stompers can be unlocked by completing the Country Club.
Be sure to Post your results to determine who the best Thief is!

We look forward to seeing all your attempts at this Challenge and future Community Challenges!

Greetings!

The build we have been promising since PAX is now live, and just in time for the rest of the long weekend!

You'll now see the improved art in the Tutorial that was on show at PAX.
Those changes had caused a lot of art in the shipping yard to break, and fixing that has been the bulk of the work leading up to this build.

Additionally, we have also added a 'Bug Report' button in the Main Menu and Paused Menu respectively.
Clicking on this will load the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/420330/discussions/1/]Bug Forums[/url] within the steam client.

We are already underway for the next update, but details on that later!
